narr: Scattered thunderstorms along a frontal boundary produced heavy rain which caused flash flooding across portions of northeast North Carolina.
ev: Flash flooding was reported on Mill Pond Road near the intersection with Route 37.
Flash flooding was reported on Willeyton Road.
Social media videos showed significant flooding along Sugar Run Road. Also, water was flowing around the foundation of at least two homes.

Significant flooding was reported in Gates county. Several pictures relayed through social media showed flooding of roads and yards up to the bottom of cars and houses. One car had water to the top of the rim of the tires.
